info.title: Matomo Reporting API for AbTesting plugin

get.description: Get an overview of all metrics per variation. It lists for each variation the value of each selected success metrics plus some base metrics like the number of visits and unique visitors the experiment had.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID to read reporting data from.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Reporting period.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date string (examples: `YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`, `now`, `today`, `tomorrow`, `yesterday`, `yesterdaySameTime`, `last week|month|year`, `lastN`, `previousN`; any strtotime-compatible value is accepted) or date range (`YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD`, `last week|month|year,today|now|yesterday|last week|month|year`). Date ranges are accepted for non-range periods to request multiple periods; relative tokens for single dates use the site timezone.

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: Experiment ID to report on.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Optional segment expression or false for none.

200.description: Data table containing the overview metrics for each variation.

get.description: Get details, such as remaining visitors, statistical significance, etc for a specific success metric.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID to read reporting data from.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Reporting period.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date string (examples: `YYYY-MM-DD`, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`, `now`, `today`, `tomorrow`, `yesterday`, `yesterdaySameTime`, `last week|month|year`, `lastN`, `previousN`; any strtotime-compatible value is accepted) or date range (`YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD`, `last week|month|year,today|now|yesterday|last week|month|year`). Date ranges are accepted for non-range periods to request multiple periods; relative tokens for single dates use the site timezone.

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: Experiment ID to report on.

parameters.name: successMetric
parameters.description: The given success metric must be "assigned" / "selected" for this experiment. A list of overall available success metrics can be fetched via "AbTesting.getAvailableSuccessMetrics". To see which success metrics are assigned to the given experiment call "AbTesting.getExperiment". Example: "nb_pageviews".

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Optional segment expression or false for none.

200.description: Data table containing the metric detail rows.

get.description: Creates a new experiment. We will require all minimal needed data in order to create the experiment so it will be directly possible to start the experiment afterwards.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID that owns the experiment.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Experiment name.

parameters.name: hypothesis
parameters.description: Experiment hypothesis text.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Experiment description text.

parameters.name: variations
parameters.description: eg array(array('name' => 'variation1'), array('name' => 'variation2', 'percentage' => '30', 'redirect_url' => 'https://www.innocraft.com')) While name is mandatory, percentage is optional and if given has to be a numer between 1 and 100. Optionally a 'redirect_url' can be passed to indicate that this variation should redirect a user to another page. Requires at least one variation to be given.

parameters.name: includedTargets
parameters.description: eg array(array('attribute' => 'url', 'type' => 'equals_simple', 'inverted' => 0, 'value' => 'http://example.com/directory')) For a list of available attribute and type values call "AbTesting.getAvailableTargetAttributes". "inverted" should be "0" or "1". Requires at least one included target to be given.

parameters.name: successMetrics
parameters.description: eg array(array('metric' => 'nb_pageviews'), array('metric' => 'bounce_count')). For a list of available metrics call "AbTesting.getAvailableSuccessMetrics". Requires at least one success metric to be given.

200.description: The ID of the created experiment.

get.description: Updates the experiment. All fields need to be set in order to update an experiment. Easiest way is to get all values for an experiment via "AbTesting.getExperiment", make the needed changes on the experiment, and send the values to "AbTesting.updateExperiment".

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: Experiment ID to update.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID that owns the experiment.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Experiment name.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Experiment description text.

parameters.name: hypothesis
parameters.description: Experiment hypothesis text.

parameters.name: variations
parameters.description: eg array(array('name' => 'variation1'), array('name' => 'variation2', 'percentage' => '30', 'redirect_url' => 'https://www.innocraft.com') While name is mandatory, percentage is optional and if given has to be a numer between 1 and 100. Optionally a 'redirect_url' can be passed to indicate that this variation should redirect a user to another page. Requires at least one variation to be given.

parameters.name: confidenceThreshold
parameters.description: accepts a value values: 90, 95, 98, 99 and  99.5

parameters.name: mdeRelative
parameters.description: a number >= 1 and <= 1000

parameters.name: percentageParticipants
parameters.description: a number between 0 and 100

parameters.name: successMetrics
parameters.description: eg array(array('metric' => 'nb_pageviews'), array('metric' => 'bounce_count')). For a list of available metrics call "AbTesting.getAvailableSuccessMetrics". Requires at least one success metric to be given.

parameters.name: includedTargets
parameters.description: eg array(array('attribute' => 'url', 'type' => 'equals_simple', 'inverted' => 0, 'value' => 'http://example.com/directory')) For a list of available attribute and type values call "AbTesting.getAvailableTargetAttributes". "inverted" should be "0" or "1". Requires at least one included target to be given.

parameters.name: excludedTargets
parameters.description: Same format as $includedTargets. Can be an empty array.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Optional date in UTC eg '2014-10-29 01:02:03'.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Optional date in UTC eg '2014-10-29 01:02:03'.

parameters.name: forwardUtmParams
parameters.description: Indicates whether redirects should forward any utm* parameters.

parameters.name: forwardAllQueryParams
parameters.description: Indicates whether redirects should forward all query parameters.

get.description: Starts an experiment immediately. Usually not needed to call this method as by default an experiment will be started as soon as we notice the first tracking request for this experiment unless the experiment has a scheduled start date.

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: Experiment ID to start.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID that owns the experiment.

get.description: Finishes (stops) the given experiment. Only a created or running experiment can be finished. The experiment will be finished immediately and no tracking requests for such an experiment will be accepted anymore. Make sure to remove an embedded JavaScript code from your website once it has been finished.

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: Experiment ID to finish.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID that owns the experiment.

get.description: Archives the given experiment. Once an experiment has been archived, it won't be available in reports and segments anymore. It will be also not possible anymore to update this experiment.

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: Experiment ID to archive.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID that owns the experiment.

get.description: Get the HTML code to embed the A/B Test JavaScript tracking file. Returns eg "<script src="..."></script>".

200.description: HTML script tag or an empty string when the tracker is already included.

get.description: Gets the JavaScript embed code to run an experiment. Will return an empty string and remove the experiment from the site automatically as soon as it has been finished or archived

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: Experiment ID to embed.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID that owns the experiment.

200.description: JavaScript embed code or an empty string when the experiment is finished/archived.

get.description: Get a list of all experiments for given site.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID to list experiments for.

200.description: List of experiments for the site.

get.description: Get a list of active experiments.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID to list experiments for.

200.description: List of active experiments for the site.

get.description: Get a list of experiments by status. To get a list of available statuses call "AbTesting.getAvailableStatuses".

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID to list experiments for.

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: One or more status identifiers to filter by. Example: "running" or array('running', 'finished').

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: Experiment ID to fetch.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID that owns the experiment.

200.description: Experiment data or false when not found.

get.description: Deletes the given experiment. It won't be possible to undo this. There's also the possibility to archive an experiment via "Experiment.archiveExperiment"

parameters.name: idExperiment
parameters.description: Experiment ID to delete.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID that owns the experiment.

get.description: Get a list of valid experiment statuses (eg "running", "finished", ...)

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID for permission checks.

application/vnd.ms-excel.example:
value	name
created	Created
running	Running
finished	Finished
archived	Archived

get.description: Get a list of all available success metrics.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Site ID to resolve goal-based metrics for.

200.description: Available metric identifiers with display names.

application/vnd.ms-excel.example:
value	name
nb_pageviews	Pageviews
bounce_count	Bounces
sum_visit_length	Time on website
nb_conversions	Total Conversions
nb_revenue	Total Revenue
nb_conversions_goal_1	"Conversions ""Goal Test"""
nb_revenue_goal_1	"Revenue ""Goal Test"""

tags.name: AbTesting
tags.description: API endpoints for creating, managing, and reporting on A/B tests. Includes reporting data for experiment metrics and details. Exposes experiment lifecycle controls, variation setup, targeting rules, and success metric reporting.
